stories.title: WWE SummerSlam Night 2: Live results and analysis for Roman Reigns vs. Seth Rollins
stories.summary: Sach Chandan breaks down all the action from the second night of SummerSlam in Minneapolis.

stories.title: Sources: Yankees land Garcia in trade with Nats
stories.summary: Luis Garcia Jr., who is hitting .283 with 23 homers, has been traded from the Nationals to the Yankees in exchange for four right-handed pitchers, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Clowney returning to roots, plans to join Texans
stories.summary: Jadeveon Clowney is returning to the Texans, the team that selected him No. 1 in the 2014 NFL draft.

stories.title: Rays acquire Peralta from Mets, bolster rotation
stories.summary: The Rays acquired Freddy Peralta in a trade with the Mets in a move that gives Tampa Bay one of the AL's best rotations for the stretch run.

stories.title: Fever loss draws rallies for, against Cunningham
stories.summary: A crowd of critics and supporters of Indiana guard Sophie Cunningham's stance on transgender participation in women's sports gathered around and inside Target Center in Minneapolis as the Indiana Fever lost 108-100 to the Minnesota Lynx on Sunday.
